description:
AI receptionist calls, voicemail and follow-ups.

Connect VeraDial to review your business phone activity in ChatGPT: summarize receptionist calls and voicemail transcripts, review text conversations, identify missed calls needing attention, and draft follow-up replies. Check your phone lines, contacts, saved receptionist settings and usage.

New to VeraDial? Check what remains in your setup and follow one link to continue on the VeraDial website with the same account. Business details, phone verification and phone-line setup happen there. Connecting the plugin alone does not activate a receptionist. A VeraDial account is required. VeraDial phone lines are available in the US and Canada.

The connector reads only the connected account. It does not place calls, send texts, buy phone numbers, change settings or process payments. Follow-ups are drafts for you to review and use in VeraDial. Audio recordings are not exposed.

defaultPrompt: Help me finish setting up my VeraDial receptionist.
Give me a brief of recent calls and voicemail, with follow-ups in priority order.
Draft a follow-up for a caller from my latest VeraDial activity.
